name: doc-reverify-weekly
prompt: Re-run the documentation lint for the workspace doc briefs. For each doc-work/*/doc-brief.json, run `python3 $DOC_PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/doc-lint/scripts/doc_lint.py --brief <path>` (the /doc:write lint stage), compare the fresh doc-lint.json verdicts to the recorded reports, and write a short result to records/. If any document regressed from pass to fail or stale, say so explicitly in the run summary.
